inputs.modified_text: This is framed as a threat to “responsible citizens,” but the real question is whether gun design and sales rules can prevent harm and hold powerful manufacturers accountable. Lawmakers should be transparent about who the rules apply to, while prioritizing the safety of communities most exposed to gun violence—not treating industry interests as more important than people’s lives.
